root_cause.text: An optimization in the `drm/xe` driver permitted skipping the execution queue schedule toggle and GuC suspend sequence when the queue was idle, which inadvertently bypassed the GPU context switch required to flush TLB entries for invalidated userptr VMAs.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description identifies that the idle-skip optimization bypasses GuC suspend, leading to missed TLB invalidation; the patch diff removes the `EXEC_QUEUE_STATE_IDLE_SKIP_SUSPEND` state flag and conditional checks to enforce unconditional schedule toggling during suspend.

intent_record.intent_summary: Removes obsolete helper functions for managing the idle skip suspend state flag.
intent_record.what: Deleted three static helper functions (exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend, set_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend, clear_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend) that manipulated the EXEC_QUEUE_STATE_IDLE_SKIP_SUSPEND atomic flag.
intent_record.how: Eliminates the specific state management logic for idle skip suspend; reduces code complexity assuming the functionality is no longer referenced or required.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove conditional skip logic to guarantee ring tail update for non-parallel exec queues.
intent_record.what: Removed the condition !exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend(q) from the else-if statement.
intent_record.how: This ensures xe_lrc_set_ring_tail is always called for non-parallel queues in this block, regardless of the idle-skip suspension status.

intent_record.intent_summary: Removed obsolete idle skip suspend handling code from exec queue resume message processing
intent_record.what: Removed all code handling exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend() from __guc_exec_queue_process_msg_resume(), including conditional checks, lrc ring tail updates, and context scheduling calls
intent_record.how: Eliminates the idle skip suspend feature path during exec queue resume processing, preventing any special handling when queues transition through idle states while suspended

intent_record.intent_summary: Simplified suspend logic by removing idle_skip_suspend conditional, ensuring all fault-mode queues are properly marked for resume.
intent_record.what: Removed the 'idle_skip_suspend' boolean variable and its associated logic. Simplified the condition from '!idle_skip_suspend && has_deps' to just 'has_deps'. Removed the conditional stats increment for skipped LR queues. Changed 'need_resume |= !idle_skip_suspend' to unconditional 'need_resume = true'.
intent_record.how: At runtime, all exec queues in fault mode will now always set need_resume to true during suspend, regardless of their idle/skip-suspend status. The early return path is simplified to only check has_deps. Stats tracking for skipped LR queues is eliminated.

Group 2 explicitly removes the 'idle skip suspend handling code' and associated helper functions, directly targeting and eliminating the specific logic mechanism responsible for the vulnerability.

The group directly addresses the root cause by removing the conditional skip logic that permitted bypassing necessary execution queue toggles and synchronization sequences. This ensures the GPU context switch and TLB flush mechanisms are no longer incorrectly skipped.

The vulnerability root cause identifies an optimization ('idle_skip_suspend') that allowed skipping the GuC suspend sequence when idle, bypassing necessary TLB flushes. Group 6 explicitly removes this conditional, directly addressing the mechanism that permitted the unsafe behavior.
